title: Chapter 353 Arena
content:
Chapter 353 Arena

After leaving the Treasure Pavilion, Wang Shuo found an inn and ordered some food.

Here, you have to have money to enjoy.

There are many ways to get Shura coins. You can participate in the competition in the arena or the competition in the Colosseum.

Or you can go to the wild to hunt demon pills and collect some precious medicinal materials, which can be exchanged for Shura coins.

If you lose your fighting ability, you can also go to these big forces and be a waiter or something.

Jobs like sweeping the floor and guarding the door also need people to do it.

As long as you can put down your dignity and face, you won’t starve to death.

At the table next to Wang Shuo, several fierce people were discussing the afternoon competition.

"Brother, why don't we give up this afternoon's competition!"

"The opponent is Jiang Mu, a newly promoted top general!"

"What are you afraid of? In Yingying Town, everything must follow the rules. No one dares to fight in Yingying Town. So, don't be afraid of his brother Jiang Song."

"But the Songjiang Gang is large in number and powerful. If we offend them, we will not have a good harvest in the future!"

Someone at the same table worried.

"Yingying Town is solid, but the generals are changing. The speed of power change in this place is faster than a young wife turning against her."

"Maybe in a few days, another force will rise, and it is not surprising to replace it."

"As long as we brothers are united, maybe the next Songjiang Gang will be us!"

After talking with several people, Wang Shuo understood.

This Songjiang Gang is a powerful gang that has emerged in recent months.

Jiang Song has risen strongly with his own strength and has obtained the qualification to sit on an equal footing with several old forces.

Wang Shuo also had to exclaim: Awesome!

After a hearty meal, Wang Shuo also wanted to go to the arena.

Although no one could directly control the arena, there were still many buildings outside, and many forces were stationed nearby and built casinos.

As long as someone went to challenge, they would open the odds as quickly as possible for people to place bets.

Wang Shuo ignored those casinos and walked straight into the arena.

At this time, there were two passages in a hall, one showing the audience seats and the other the registration office.

The minimum requirement for participating in the arena battle is a Shura Order.

As long as both parties agree, additional bets can be added.

These are the default rules of the arena. As long as you admit defeat, you will be teleported out.

In other words, if you admit defeat in time, you will not die.

After entering the registration office, it is also an independent space. Wang Shuo clicked to register.

There are resurrection coins and a mechanism for admitting defeat. In the first battle, he was in a good mood.

There are several ways to register. One is to make an appointment for a battle by name. This requires both parties to discuss privately, and then you can register.

The second is the challenge mode, where generals can put themselves on the challenge list, and other generals can choose to challenge.

The third is the random mode. After signing up, you can even hide your name and appearance. This is also the challenge mode that is least likely to expose yourself.

Neither the opponent nor the audience can see the appearance of the contestant.

Except for yourself, the equipment and weapons on your body will be unified.

This also led to almost no one watching this competition.

Wang Shuo participated for the first time and chose this random mode.

Soon, the registration was successful.

Not long after, Wang Shuo was teleported into a ring.

On the other side of the ring, an opponent wearing white clothes and holding a long sword appeared.

But on his face, no facial features can be seen.

Wang Shuo thought, I should look like this in his eyes!

Very good!

In this way, this competition is very fair, and you can hone your fighting ability.

Both of them rushed towards their opponents without any nonsense.
